mvp: A local inventory app that records item names and quantities and shows current inventory while offline.
assumptions: A minimal local workflow is sufficient for initial planning; storage technology and role model are not approved.

acceptance_backlog.criterion: With network unavailable, a user can record an item name and quantity and immediately see that item and quantity in current inventory.
acceptance_backlog.verification_gate: Demonstrate create-and-list flow with network disabled.

acceptance_backlog.criterion: Recorded inventory remains available after closing and reopening the local app while offline.
acceptance_backlog.verification_gate: Record inventory, restart the app offline, and compare names and quantities.
acceptance_backlog.decision_note: Persistence is a proposed MVP interpretation to confirm before implementation.

open_decisions: User roles and whether access control is needed: TBD
Quantity rules, including whether fractions or negatives are allowed: TBD
Confirm local persistence expectation and backup needs: TBD
evidence: Only the supplied needs were available; no implementation or baseline was inspected or created.
risks: Role, platform, and quantity decisions may change scope.
next_bounded_action: Review this MVP backlog with the volunteer and resolve target platform, quantity rules, and roles before seeking implementation authorization.
